        int[] temp = dp.clone();
        dp[middle] = 1;
        int answer = 0;
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int c = n - 1 - i;
            temp = dp.clone();

                dp[j] = 0;
            }
            int limit = (c * (c - 1)) / 2;
            int count = 0;
            for (int cur = -c; cur < 0; cur++) {
                int pairs = c + cur + 1;
                for (int j = middle - cur + 1; j <= middle + limit; j++) {
                    if (j >= 0 && j < dp.length) {
                        count = (int) ((count + (long) temp[j] * pairs) % m);
                    }
                }
            }
            int mult = (i == 0) ? 1 : factorial[i - 1];
            answer = (int) ((answer + (long) count * mult) % m);
            for (int j = middle - limit; j <= middle + limit; j++) {
